charterDraft.sharpenedIdea: A SaaS tool that lets creators and small businesses schedule social media posts across multiple platforms with built-in timezone intelligence and intelligent retry logic for failed posts.
charterDraft.mvpDefinition: Version 1 launches with OAuth integration for Twitter/X and LinkedIn (read: post scheduling, no analytics). Users can connect one account per platform, write or paste posts, set a scheduled time in their local timezone, and the tool queues and publishes them at the exact time. The system retries failed posts once and notifies the user of any delivery errors. No custom graphics, video, or carousel support—text and link posts only. Waitlist signup and email-based onboarding for trial users.
